verdict.rationale: Fathom's API/SDKs let you pull transcripts, summaries, recordings, and user data programmatically (get-transcript, get-summary, request-a-download, users endpoints), which is a form of data export, but there is no documented bulk 'export all my data' feature, explicit open-format (JSON/CSV) statement, or GDPR-style account data takeout described in the evidence. Missing for 10: a unified full-account export mechanism, explicit open-format guarantee, and any mention of data portability tied to account closure/leaving the service.
